bio.text: Becky Stille is the Democratic nominee for Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 12 primary.
As of September 2025 she lived in South Sioux City and worked as an agricultural lab tech, according to the Nebraska Examiner.
Her campaign website describes her as a life-long Nebraska resident.

sources.title: Democrat Becky Stille runs in Nebraska's most conservative congressional district
